ALLOWED_INTERPRETATION: A historical conditional probability on one venue: how often the stated event followed the state, beside the same probability without the state after the nuisance adjustment, with N and an interval and its status («Проверено» or «Гипотеза»).

DH1-B.ENDPOINT_TEXT: 1 if price reaches close*(1 + d*X) before close*(1 - d*X) within 4h, 0 if the reverse, 0.5 if neither or both in the same bar; d = move direction, X = half of the 4h corridor half-width
DH1-B.TITLE: Sharp 15-minute move: which edge is reached first in the next 4h

DH1-L.ENDPOINT_TEXT: the close 4h after the touch bar is beyond the level, on the side of the approach
DH1-L.TITLE: First touch of a key level: what changes how often price holds beyond it

DH1-B1.COMPARATOR: spot taker net flow zero or against the move
DH1-B1.MECHANISM: A sharp move carried by spot flow reflects unlevered demand; a move carried by perpetual flow alone is more often leverage that unwinds.
DH1-B1.STATE_TEXT: spot taker net flow over the three 5m bars of the move points in the move direction

DH1-B2.COMPARATOR: spot share at or below its 24h share
DH1-B2.MECHANISM: Moves with unusually high spot participation are less leverage-driven, so they are less often reversed.
DH1-B2.STATE_TEXT: spot share of spot+perp quote volume during the move exceeds its share over the 24h before the move

DH1-L1.COMPARATOR: spot taker net flow zero or against the approach
DH1-L1.MECHANISM: A push into a level carried by unlevered spot buying (or selling) is less likely to be unwound than one carried by perpetual flow alone.
DH1-L1.STATE_TEXT: spot taker net flow over the hour into the touch (touch bar included) points in the approach direction

DH1-L2.MECHANISM: A level that coincides with other watched levels concentrates resting orders and stops, so the reaction there differs from an isolated level.
DH1-L2.STATE_TEXT: another objective level of a different kind lies within 0.15 % of the touched level at the touch

DH1-L3.COMPARATOR: the level price was traded during those 24h
DH1-L3.MECHANISM: Orders and stops accumulate at a level the market has not visited for a while; a recently traded level carries less of them.
DH1-L3.STATE_TEXT: the level price was not traded during the 24h before the touch bar

CLASSIFICATION.DISCOVERY: PROMISING_PROTOTYPE if Holm p < 0.05, |shift| >= 0.03 and Brier skill > 0 (and heterogeneity not failed when assessable); HETEROGENEOUS_UNEXPLAINED if only heterogeneity fails; NO_INCREMENTAL_STRUCTURE if the 95% CI lies inside (-0.03, 0.03), or the shift is significant but below the bar or not calibrated; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
CLASSIFICATION.REPLICATION: only PROMISING_PROTOTYPE cells; SUPPORTED_UNCONDITIONAL if same sign, Holm p < 0.05, |shift| >= 0.03, frozen Brier skill > 0 and heterogeneity not failed; REPLICATION_INCONCLUSIVE if the replication surface was not powered and nothing significant; otherwise REPLICATION_FAILED

ESTIMAND: Coefficient of the state indicator in a linear probability model of the endpoint on the state and the nuisance dummies (first level dropped); every event weighs the same.
FORBIDDEN_INTERPRETATION: No trade call (buy/sell, long/short now, entry, target, take-profit), no edge claim, no causal claim about participants, no wording stronger than the status.

HETEROGENEITY.TEST: Cochran-type Q with fixed inverse-variance weights, null by permuting week clusters across epochs (1000 draws, seed 20261005); opposite-sign one-sided p < 0.05; NOT_ASSESSABLE when the outcome-blind power to detect a 2x epoch difference is below 0.5 (does not fail the cell)

INFERENCE: Cluster bootstrap over ISO weeks cut at epoch boundaries, 2000 draws, seed base 20261004; two-sided p = 2 min(P(b*<=0), P(b*>=0)); Holm within each card at 0.05.
NO_RESCUE: A failed cell is never re-scored with new parameters, states, horizons, sides, baselines or claim type.

PRACTICAL_BAR.BRIER_SKILL: > 0 (discovery: leave-one-epoch-out cross-fit; replication: frozen discovery models)
PRACTICAL_BAR.RATIONALE: owner bar 2026-10-04: 3 pp against 'обычно' plus calibration; the product's materiality floor (beta MATERIAL_DIFF = 0.03)

PROSPECTIVE.EXPOSURE_HANDLING: The bot may show the frozen discovery estimate («Гипотеза») during the window. The prospective analysis uses only events after the freeze and the frozen discovery model; showing a frozen number cannot change BTC outcomes, and no interim statistic is computed.
PROSPECTIVE.SOURCE: Binance Vision daily 5m klines (USD-M BTCUSDT and spot BTCUSDT), read after each day closes

DISCOVERY.PERP: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 (Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 1m klines, aggregated to 5m)

REPLICATION.PERP: DH1_BITMEX_XBTUSD_TRADES_5M_V0 (BitMEX XBTUSD public trades, aggregated to 5m)

TARGET_CLASS: UNCONDITIONAL over the declared event population of each card
